_comment: Single source of truth for model presets, consumed by BOTH the bash CLI
(olivia.sh, via presets.py) and the Python model router (model_router.py).
Previously this data lived in olivia.sh's preset_field()/normalize_preset()
case statements; it was extracted here so the router and the CLI agree on
exactly which preset maps to which model / container / node.
Per-preset fields:
aliases            - alternate names the CLI and router accept (case-insensitive)
model              - HuggingFace repo id passed to vLLM as MODEL (the served name unless overridden)
served_model_name  - optional; what vLLM serves the model AS (defaults to `model`). Routing also matches this.
nodes / gpus / pp  - SLURM/vLLM shape: NUM_NODES, GPUs-per-node (intra-node TP), pipeline-parallel size
container_prefix   - sandbox name is vllm-<container_prefix>-<index>-sandbox
index              - default container index for the preset
storage            - HF-cache tier: 'projects' (persistent, the default) or 'work'
(at-risk /cluster/work, NRIS auto-purges after 21-42 days). olivia.sh
derives HF_HOME from this per preset for `server start`/`prefetch` so you
never hand-pass the override; 'work' swaps the /cluster/projects/<proj>
HF_HOME prefix for /cluster/work/projects/<proj>. A NEUTRAL TIER HINT, not
an absolute path: the actual roots stay in mise.local.toml so this file is
portable. Placement is quota-driven and changes — keep it in sync with the
hf-weights-storage-split note.
port               - vLLM serve port. Defaults to 8000 for every preset because each server job owns
its GPU node(s) exclusively, so two models never collide on a node — the router
tells them apart by the per-preset SLURM job name (vllm-server-<preset>), not the
port. Override per preset only if you ever co-locate servers on one node.
description        - human-readable summary

glm51_v19.description: GLM-5.1 744B MoE+DSA, AWQ-4bit, vLLM v0.19.0 (recipe default)

glm51_v20.description: GLM-5.1 on vLLM v0.20.0 + RayExecutorV2 (quarantined; same wedge)

glm52_awq.description: GLM-5.2 744B MoE+DSA, AWQ-INT4 (~415 GiB), 2-node TP=4+PP=2 (reuses the glm52 container; persistent tier). VALIDATED on the glm52 container; the glm53/v0.27.1 container is an untested alternative (PR#45895 native there rather than grafted).

glm53.description: GLM-5.3 744B MoE+DSA, block-FP8, 3-node TP=4+PP=3 — GLM-5.2's base re-post-trained, so it REUSES the glm52 container (no rebuild). Weights unreleased as of 2026-08-17

glm53_v27.description: GLM-5.3 on a modern vLLM release (v0.27.1 + NGC 26.07, no PR graft) — own container, the upgrade path off glm52's pinned-main build

glm53_flash.description: GLM-5.3-Flash 320B/18B-active multimodal MoE — a DIFFERENT model from the 744B `glm53`: new arch Glm5NextForConditionalGeneration (45 layers = 34 KDA linear-attn + 11 NoPE sparse-MLA, 288 experts, mHC), native FP8 ~306 GiB, 1M ctx, MIT. Fits ONE node at TP=4 (tighter than glm47-AWQ's ~358 GB) and hybrid attn makes KV cheap. SOURCE BUILD on vLLM v0.32.0 + NGC 26.07 — glm5_next is native from v0.30.0 onward (NOT v0.29.0, despite what the recipe page claims), and v0.32.0's FlashInfer 0.7.0.post1 clears the >=0.6.18 NoPE-sparse-MLA floor. MTP head ships as layer 45 and vLLM registers Glm5NextMTPModel, but it is OFF by default (~7 GiB on a tight fit, unproven here). ⚠️ Hopper MUST run BF16 KV — --kv-cache-dtype fp8 is Blackwell-only for this model

glm53_flash_prebuilt.description: GLM-5.3-Flash from the PREBUILT arm64 image vllm/vllm-openai:glm53-flash (container index 2) — the FALLBACK, kept only in case the v0.32.0 source build regresses. This was the primary path while glm5_next was absent from the public vLLM repo (Aug-Sep 2026); v0.30.0 made it unnecessary. Same serve shape and same Hopper BF16-KV rule as glm53_flash

borealis.description: Borealis 27B (National Library of Norway) Norwegian-centric instruct model, Gemma-3 arch, BF16 ~54 GB on a SINGLE GH200 (TP=1), multimodal SigLIP tower, 128K ctx. Shares the glm53 container

dsv4flash.description: DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 MoE (256+1 experts, 6 active), block-FP8 ~167 GB, 1 node TP=4, 1M ctx via YaRN. ⚠️ BLOCKED on vLLM v0.27.1 + NGC 26.07: its compressor unconditionally uses cutedsl at head_dim=512 on CUDA, which needs `quack`, and quack-kernels pins nvidia-cutlass-dsl==4.6.2 against vLLM 4.6.0 — unsatisfiable. Preset kept for a future vLLM. See README

dsv41.description: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash — 552B backbone + 196B Engram memory, 8B active per prompt token / 16B per output token, 40 layers, 384+1 experts (6 active), 1M ctx via YaRN, vision-language, MIT. Arch DeepseekV41ForCausalLM, native in vLLM from v0.30.0 → REUSES the glm53flash container (v0.32.1.dev0), no build. THE POINT OF THIS PRESET: Engram's 196.6B-param hash tables (259.5 GiB, ~47 GiB/rank at TP4) are SPARSELY accessed by token lookup, so `--engram-config {cpu_offload:true}` parks them in pinned Grace host memory and the 96 GB cards hold only the backbone. KV is near-free (890 B/token, FP4 latents shared across layers) so WEIGHTS, not cache, set capacity. ⚠️ Needs fp8 KV (like dsv4, INVERSE of GLM-5.3-Flash) and the FLASHINFER_MLA_SPARSE_DSV41 backend — so it is BLOCKED until flashinfer imports in our container. DSpark is the only spec-decode method (V4.1 dropped MTP)

lagunas21.description: Laguna S 2.1 (Poolside) MoE (256 experts, 10 active), FP8 ~131 GB, 1 node TP=4, 1M ctx, alternating full/sliding-window attn. Speculative decode via the separate DFlash draft (vLLM registers DFlashLagunaForCausalLM). Shares the glm53 container

qwen38.description: Qwen3.8 27B DENSE multimodal (Qwen3_5ForConditionalGeneration), block-FP8 ~30 GB on a SINGLE GH200 card (TP=1), hybrid linear+full attn, 262K ctx. Shares the glm53 container — vLLM v0.27.1 registers this arch natively

kimi.description: Kimi K2.6 1T MoE (32B active), native int4, MLA, multimodal

kimi27.description: Kimi K2.7-Code 1T MoE (32B active), native int4 (reuses kimi container)

laguna.description: Laguna M.1 225B MoE (23B active), block-FP8, single-node TP=4, CUDAGraph on

ornith.description: Ornith 1.0 397B MoE (Qwen3.5) flagship, block-FP8 (~400 GB), 2-node TP=4+PP=2, native MTP (PP-gated), 256K ctx

ornith_gh200.description: Ornith 1.0 35B MoE (Qwen3.5, ~3B active) FP8 on a SINGLE GH200 card (TP=1), MTP on, 256K ctx — max single-user throughput (shares the ornith container)

glm52_awq_1n.description: GLM-5.2 AWQ-INT4 SINGLE-node TP=4 via Grace weight offload (--cpu-offload-gb); no PP wedge, long-context experiment. Requires CPU_OFFLOAD_GB (auto-defaults 40).

glm52_awq_mtp.description: GLM-5.2 AWQ-INT4 body + grafted FP8 MTP layer-78 (dnhkng graft of GLM-5.2-FP8). LOCAL-PATH model. Single-node TP=4 + Grace offload + MTP spec-decode (auto-on via 'MTP' in path). Container vLLM MUST carry patches/vllm-awq-fp8-mtp-quant-config.patch (live-patch or rebuild).
